summary: Implemented directed channels with capacity, latency, costs, loss and distortion. Operator regression review corrected three missing causal links. 42 channel tests and all 127 tests pass; 160 seeded cases and four topology results reproduce with unchanged modeled outcomes.
reviewer: Assigned AE-005 Codex worker self-review followed by root Codex operator source and regression review; neither is a human participant
review_notes: Reviewed AE-004 actual source, tests, fixture, receipt and delivery recovery at entry; its receipt, 41 tests and replay passed. Reviewed finite admission/time/cost, public-view access boundaries, unchanged uncertainty, source-dependent copies, identity controls and causal event links. A real repeated-send parent assertion failed and was repaired after the initial missing-module red/35-test green. Final 39 focused tests, seeded controls and explicit fast/costly versus slow/cheap constraints support this bounded disposition. See channels.md for findings and scoped ledger; no architecture acceptance inferred. Subsequent root review found missing forwarded-distortion, restored-acquisition and recipient-departure ancestry. Three new tests failed before the correction and now pass. The original worker receipt and outputs are archived; operator-review.md and red/green evidence explain the revised acceptance. All prior inputs remain unchanged; only the listed source, tests and regenerated causal trace/manifest artifacts changed.
limitations: Author self-review only. Independent controller validation, target-domain or architecture acceptance, integration and publication are not established. No empirical calibration or human participation/comprehension evidence.

Independent per-message loss/distortion draws, fixed-size messages, exact syntactic distortion and one-time connection costs are toy assumptions. Correlated outages, buffered service and broader topology/workload sensitivity remain untested.

Fast and cheap authored routes satisfy different invented constraints; this is not proof of non-dominance across all graphs or that players understand/enjoy the choices. With zero connection cost unused edges are free.

Endpoints are actors; a sender may relay readable artifact content. No direct artifact destination, automatic broadcast, forwarding, routing, retry, discovery, channel removal, budget enforcement or ongoing maintenance is provided.

Source labels preserve declared dependence, not source authenticity or truth. Confidence/freshness are copied unchanged, trust is metadata, and no authority or independent evidence is inferred from delivery.

Single trusted owner, same store/history/clock and reserved communication: generated-ID namespace are caller contracts. Caller must pop and dispatch scheduled work. Save/resume, concurrency, hostile mutation and cross-owner atomicity are unproven; histories/RNG streams are not bounded for arbitrary long workloads.

AE-004 passed before edits. Updating only MA-04 makes its assumptions binding historical; archived entry bytes match the original and every other predecessor binding remains unchanged. The actual expected post-edit checker failure is preserved.

Initial red was missing-module collection, not a pre-existing behavioral assertion. Later actual lineage assertion failure and experiment-authoring SyntaxError were repaired; original failing outputs remain visible. No tested seed failed invariants; loss outcomes remain in all-seed results.
Shared ledger and ADR register are outside allowed paths; this packet uses the scoped ledger in research/experiments/AE-005/channels.md.

The single permitted git add attempt failed with exit 128: shared Git metadata is read-only. No worker commit exists, and no retry or push was attempted. Launch-specific policy requires final status failed until controller/operator delivery recovery.

Historical worker validations at 39 focused/124 total tests describe the pre-correction source. Current operator checks pass 42/127 and replay model ae005-one-hop-v2-causal-ancestry. Original worker receipt and experiment outputs are retained in before-causal-review/.
test_method: Focused missing-API red/green, then actual lineage assertion red/green with negative/boundary/invariant tests; same-runtime seed replay, actor-kind/reversed-registration controls and paired sensitivity/topology cases.
